thread:
Alex P.: ok team — Q3 initiative (predictive prefetch MVP) needs a quick cross-team alignment. I want a clear list of hard blockers and gating criteria by EOD Wed. can each owner call out constraints?
Maria L.: runtime: main risk is KV-cache warmup + batching policy. we need a deterministic preload path for high-frequency tenants.
Jamal R.: infra: capacity looks ok for pilot but autoscale latency on warm nodes is ~45s right now. need prewarm buckets or reserved slots.
Priya S.: security: dataflow looks fine but we need an approved KMS policy for cache encryption and an audit trail for prefetch triggers. compliance wants a short doc.
Ben K.: eng-sre: suggest ephemeral prewarm pool + health checks. rollout gating: abort if p50 tail increases by >25% on synthetic traffic.
Tara O.: product-ops: customers (3 pilots) expect <200ms median gen time. they will drop if p90 >500ms. include those in launch criteria.
Alex P.: actionable asks: (1) Maria: propose preload algorithm + perf target; (2) Jamal: prewarm plan + cost estimate; (3) Priya: KMS policy + audit checklist; (4) Ben: monitoring + rollback runbook. deadline Wed EOD.
Maria L.: quick note: preload approaches we tested: prefix-only, heuristic LRU, request-trace-driven. prefix-only is cheapest but misses multi-turn. leaning to request-trace-driven.
Jamal R.: prewarm options: reserved slots (committed cost), ephemeral warmers (cheaper but slower). cost delta est: reserved = +12% infra bill for pilot. ephemeral needs tuning.
Priya S.: draft KMS snippet I'll share in #eng-security, but core requirement: prefetch keys must be separate context and logged with request id. also need failure modes where prefetch fails but request proceeds without cached KV.
Ben K.: monitoring checklist (short):
```
- prefetch_success_rate
- prefetch_latency_ms
- kv_cache_hit_rate
- end_to_end_p50/p90
- synthetic_tail_regressions
```
if any synthetic_tail_regressions spike >20% => auto rollback.
Alex P.: acceptance criteria (proposed):
- functional: prefetch warms KV for 80% of top prefixes during pilot traffic window
- perf: median gen time <=200ms, p90 <=450ms on pilot tenants
- reliability: no greater than 15% increase in overall token cost vs baseline; rollback triggers defined
- security: KMS policy + audit trace in place
- ops: runbook + monitoring + 1 canary rollout with traffic ramp schedule
Maria L.: can implement prefix analysis + trace-driven seeding in two sprints if infra provides prewarm API. need Jamal signoff.
Jamal R.: we can expose prewarm API by next Tue if we deprioritize one non-critical infra task. cost/ops tradeoff to confirm with finance.
Priya S.: I can review KMS snippet by Mon, need small privacy review; please add sample payloads.
Tara O.: I'll notify pilots of tentative acceptance targets and ask them to prepare eval prompts.
Ben K.: I'll draft rollback runbook with steps + 1-click flag toggle. will include synthetic job config.
Alex P.: risks capture: 1) cost spike if prefetch overshoots, 2) increased token throughput leading to throttles, 3) silent cache corruption — add canary and checksum on cached entries.
Maria L.: noted. checksum idea good — we can add simple CRC per entry. extra 0.5ms.
Jamal R.: agree on canary staging. ops plan: canary -> 10% -> 40% -> 100% over 6 hours with health checks at each step.
Priya S.: plus contingency: KMS rotation window must be compatible with cached key TTLs. document TTL policy.
Alex P.: next sync: Tue 11am for terse checkpoints (15m). owners post short PRDs in the #product-docs folder by EOD Wed. i'll collect and escalate any blockers. thx :rocket:
deploy-bot: scheduled meeting created: Tue 11:00 — 'Prefetch cross-team checkpoint' (calendar invite sent)
